summary.name: User Flows
summary.one_liner: User Flows is a Sketch plugin that generates flow diagrams by drawing links between Artboards.
use_cases: exporting flow diagrams for design reviews
summary.what_it_does: The plugin lets you define links between artboards in Sketch by selecting a layer and a destination artboard. It can add and manage conditions to show conditional flow logic on artboards. Running the Generate Flow Diagram command lets you pick a starting screen, enter flow details, and produce a diagram. Connections are drawn over the artboards and can be redrawn or hidden with keyboard shortcuts. Output resolution, colors, and an author name on exported flows can be adjusted.
notable: Generates flow diagrams directly from Sketch artboards and layer links
Supports conditional flow logic through managed Conditions
Keyboard shortcuts for defining links, generating, redrawing and hiding connections
caveats: Requires Sketch; installed by double-clicking the .sketchplugin file
